data.rationale: The proposal matches the true sequence (Check my bus, Track my bus, Service Number tab, type the service number) and names the correct single parameter. Its only additions are an optional suggestion-select step and a final "Find my bus" click, which fit the generic "select suggestion/submit" step, so a browser automation could be built from it.
